t: The Ultragrime Pro Power Clean Plastic-Free Wipes are extra-thick, large-capacity wet wipes designed for heavy-duty cleanup tasks. Each pack contains 70 sheets and are ideal for busy plumbers and builders working on messy sites. The XXL 38cm by 25cm cloth wipes easily remove stubborn oil, grease, paint, silicone and adhesive from hands, tools and surfaces. Featuring an organic solvent formulation, these wipes stay wet for over 1 hour out of the pack and do not dry out for weeks even if the lid is left open, ensuring reliable cleaning.
b: For Medium to Heavy Duty Work
